home.title: Your private karaoke studio, ready from any link.
home.subtitle: Paste a song, drop a file, or search the web. VocalFlow turns it into a local package with original audio, backing track, and synced lyrics.

room.title: Order the setlist, then take the stage.

room.setlistHint: Move songs up or down, then play one to start.
room.emptyBody: Add or pick songs first, then come back to order tonight’s setlist.

errors.ytDlp: yt-dlp is missing. Prepare the runtime environment, then try again.
errors.ffmpeg: ffmpeg is missing or unavailable. Install ffmpeg or reinstall VocalFlow.
errors.whisper: Local transcription is not ready. Prepare the Whisper runtime before running this job.
errors.whisperTimestamped: Word-level alignment is not installed; install whisper-timestamped or use the faster fallback.
errors.separator: Backing creation is not ready. Install audio-separator or disable backing creation for this run.
errors.noPlatformSubtitles: No platform subtitles were found. Enable local fallback or choose local transcription.
errors.cookies: This video may need browser cookies or sign-in. Add browser cookies in Desktop options and try again.
errors.unsupportedMedia: This input is not a supported media file. Use an audio/video file, folder, or supported URL.
